description: CNN predicts Collatz delay from binary representation, then gradient ascent on input generates high-delay candidates. AlphaFold analogy.
mathematical_formalization: f_theta: {0,1}^B -> R. Loss: MSE(f_theta(bits(n)), delay(n)). Gradient ascent on input space.
implementation_hypothesis: Train 1D CNN on 1M pairs. Score 10M candidates. Gradient-based input optimization.
experiment_seed: 1M training pairs, CNN validation, top 100 predicted vs actual.
